items.title: Scrap junk to produce Wood
items.detail: Craft Bulk Wood at a Tinker's Workbench and scrap it, or collect wood from fallen trees northeast of Black Bear Lodge

items.title: Complete a Grunt Hunt
items.detail: Start at Highway Town Bounty Board in The Last Resort, obtain a wanted poster, and eliminate the assigned Outlaw

items.title: Complete the Quest: Disturbed Grave
items.detail: Finish a public event to receive a Pint-Sized Phantoms map, locate and dig up the grave marked on it

items.title: Kill a Gulper
items.detail: Fast travel to Gulper Lagoon where 3-4 Gulpers reliably spawn; target the head as weak spot

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom while wearing a Costume
items.detail: Equip any outfit, hat or mask with 'Costume' in description before killing a Phantom at cabins or fairgrounds

items.title: Build Anything in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Fast travel to your C.A.M.P. or claim a workshop, then place any small decoration or building piece

items.title: Collect a Garden Gnome
items.detail: Visit The General's Steakhouse in the Mire; gnomes are in the walled garden and shed behind the main building

items.title: Collect any flavor of Nuka-Cola
items.detail: Use a Nuka-Cola Collectron Station at a C.A.M.P. or program any Collectron for Nuka-Cola collection

items.title: Complete a Head Hunt
items.detail: Get a wanted poster from Highway Town Bounty Board, hang it on the board outside The Last Resort, then complete the public event

items.title: Drink Nuka-Cola
items.detail: Collect Nuka-Cola from a Nuka-Cola Collectron Station and consume it

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom while in a Team
items.detail: Join or create a team, then kill a masked Phantom cultist at cabins, campgrounds or fairgrounds

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom while wearing a Costume
items.detail: Equip any costume outfit, hat or mask before killing a Phantom; one qualifying piece is sufficient

items.title: Kill an Enemy with a Shovel during the "Disturbed Grave" Quest
items.detail: Activate Disturbed Grave quest, equip a shovel, and kill any enemy before finishing the quest; low-level insects are easiest

items.title: Complete the Quest: Disturbed Grave
items.detail: Finish a public event to receive map, locate grave, dig it up and collect ritual pile

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run, Treasure Hunter and Double Mutations
events.description: Participate in special fishing, Treasure Hunter encounters, and double mutation effects during this limited-time seasonal event.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: Mutated versions of public events appear with modified difficulty and rewards.

events.name: Double SCORE Weekend
events.description: Earn double SCORE progress on all challenges during this weekend event.

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Compete in a C.A.M.P. building contest with Slasher-themed elements for exclusive rewards.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: Participate in spooky Halloween-themed activities and earn exclusive seasonal rewards.

events.name: Double Mutations
events.description: Double mutation effects are active on all creatures during this limited-time event.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Face Halloween-themed Scorched enemies with unique rewards and special challenges available.
